name: Planetary Defense 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Planetary Defense is a fast-paced survival shooter where you assemble a powerful battle machine using modular blocks and face relentless threats from all directions. Mix and match defense, weapon, economy, and upgrade blocks to craft a build that matches your playstyle, then put it to the test across multiple arenas with unique enemy patterns and challenges.
